question: The ______ of a ray is the angle measured from the reflected ray to the normal surface.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Angle of Reflection**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Reflection-

 
• When the light rays fall on the plane surface and deviate from their path in the same medium or when a ray of light incident on the plane surface is reflected back into the same medium it is termed as Reflection.
 
 
• Example - Plane Mirror.
